Review Text:
I am rewriting this review, as my first review was softly forced. The pilot stopped the golf cart near the hangars and asked us to click the links and do the review on the spot…and then he checked our phones to see that the reviews were completed with a thank you screen showing. While I understand they need reviews as a small business, soft forcing and checking doesn’t feel like it’s the right way to do it. I’ve been on other plane tours around a couple of the other Hawaiian Islands, so I have reference points for comparison.

Pros: We did a custom tour, which is supposed to be a combination of two tours, with circumnavigation of Maui and a tour of the surrounding islands. The views of Molokai and the surrounding area were fantastic. The pilot, Eric, was skillful and we felt safe. He was a nice guy and tried his best to be a good guide.

Cons: (1) I feel like the price of our combined tour was a bit high (around 1250 for two people) especially considering the total time was only about 1.7 hours, which is about the time of just one tour. I feel like more time could have been spent around west Maui , Molokai/Lanai and Molokini rather than Hanna, which is comparatively not that impressive. I would not recommend our tour to others, based on my experience and at this price point. (2) They could use newer planes. The current single engine plane (Piper Archer) is very old. The exterior looks old and the interior is in rough shape. Again, it was safe, but the plane could at least use a new coat of paint, the seats need to be re-upholstered and the interior needs a good cleaning/vacuuming and wipe down. Also, the control pod of my headphones was coming apart with interior wires showing, and all the headphones had earmuff covers that were dirty and almost coming off…they could use disposable ear muff covers and mouthpiece covers…these things are very cheaply available on Amazon. Finally, the pilot’s clothes looked like they were not washed for weeks. Again, I think the pilot is a nice guy and I have nothing against him, but both my wife and I noticed this and thought it was strange. Cleanliness is very important…it’s the first things people notice and experience. These are simple things to fix. (3) They really need a shared office or at least a hangar where customers can sit down and wait and get checked in etc. It seems all they have is a parking spot on the tarmac and a golf cart that they use to get customers directly from their cars. This is ok, but this is just a tip based on what I’ve seen with other tour operators.

I would recommend this company over a helicopter tour because it is better for a small group. However, I would like to see some of the things I mentioned to change. They have been in business for 7 years. So I feel like some of these things should be addressed for their benefit and that of future customers. All they have to do is go experience some other airplane tours on other islands (like Kauai for example) to get more tips on how to improve.

Review Text: Whale watching with Pacific Whale was wonderful, as always. Went a little earlier this year in the hope of seeing more whales. Review Text:
Would highly recommend Maui plane rides.

We had some time before our flight at 10pm and Eric fit us in at the last minute for a flight just before sunset.

As soon as he met my kids, they were smiling, laughing and engaged. He’s great with kids. My wife was nervous and he did a great job of reassuring her.

It was an amazing sensation flying in a small plane, entirely different from commercial air travel. You can really feel the wind — and the ability to steer the plane and have it respond and the fact that my kids were able to steer were once in a lifetime memories.

The cliffs of Molokai were gorgeous and under-appreciated and beautifully lit before sunset. The West Maui mountains also look different up high.

I just really loved the experience of flying and seeing these landscapes from a unique point of view. For a moment, or perhaps an hour, I got the perspective of a bird, felt the power of the wind and it just one of the real highlights of our trip to Maui.

Highly recommend.

Review Text:
The views you get on this tour are breath taking. There are places on the islands you would never be able to see except by small plane or boat which makes the entire experience exceptional.
This is a small business so changes are possible but not cancelations. In their fine print it clearly explains that any refunds are at their discretion so be mindful of that.
The only thing I really didn't like and the reason I deducted 1 star is because when the trip was over and the operator had been paid we were held up until everyone completed their review and he stood over everyone in the group to ensure he only received 5 star reviews and even coached what he thought you should write. I didn't like that. If people feel pressured to write you a 5 star review, how honest is it? Let the tour speak for itself.
Also, the ad says you do as much or as little as you want, that it's a flying lesson but really its just a photo op. You really only take the controls for a few minutes. Long story short (as I could go on for many more paragraphs); if you want a lifetime memory and can find a way to line up a time to get in the air, it will be something I suspect you will treasure as much as we do.

Review Title: No question - best way to see Maui
Review Text:
Eric gave us such a wonderful experience this morning on our flight seeing trip between Maui and the Big Island. It was a gorgeous flight and we got to see Haleakala, Waipi’o Valley, Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa. We also were able to view the site of the latest lava flows from 2018 and could even still see steam rising from the fissure. What a wonderful way to see both Maui and the Big Island - even for those like us who have been visiting for almost two decades. We felt safe and secure the entire time and can’t wait to come back out on another trip. If you are trying to decide between a helicopter tour and a fixed wing - I would recommend going with Eric in a fixed wing every time - it’s a much faster way to get to the sites, and far smoother than any helicopter tour we have done on Maui with other providers.

Mahalo for the great flight!

Review Text: The entire experience may just have been the highlight of our trip to Maui. Steve was an excellent pilot and tour guide during our sunset flight. Steve was extremely attentive to making the trip the best quality possible, even by taking precaution to avoid turbulence in areas that were known for it. Flying over the strait towards Lanai to see the sunset was great because we avoided much of the bumpiness that began to form. We loved our flight and highly recommend that everyone ask to fly with Steve, as he made our flight for our one year anniversary so enjoyable and fun. Review Text: My husband and I were originally looking for a helicopter experience, but were given the suggestion by our concierge to go on a more intimate plane ride with Eric of Maui Plane Rides. We were able to see all the views and sights that we had wanted to see in a helicopter, but in a much more intimate setting. Eric was a wonderful tour guide, giving us tons of information about what we were seeing. We were flying during the humpback whale season, and any time we saw a whale, he would circle around so we could see it better. The whole experience felt very personalized. He took some photos for us and after the flight, gave us a nice cold drink which was much appreciated! Out of all of our honeymoon activities, this one was my favorite, and I highly recommend Maui Plane Rides to anyone looking for an amazing aerial experience.

Review Title: Island views on a perfect weather day
Review Text: Looking for a flight around Maui and other neighboring islands that are part of Maui County? We were and found Maui Plane Rides a great choice for seeing various landscapes and to have great views of Maui mountains on one of the clearest mornings possible. The pilot was very responsive to a last minute flight request; we had waited for better weather and visibility that happened to be our last day on the island. We were able to see sea cliffs, lush green and more rugged landscapes, ports and other special features that make Maui County special and memorable. A great day to fly with lower winds and visibility to Big Island in the distance. Wonderful photo options from both sides of the plane that we will cherish as memories for years to come! Small plane accommodations for taller and average size tourists, comfortable seating and communications. Smooth take-off and landing with little wind turbulence coming around mountainous areas to be expected. Worth the cost compared to other flights; same cost for up to three people, so both of us got to fly on a beautiful morning flight to start the day! Thanks so much to our pilot for the touring info of each location and great memories of favorite beaches and the blue/aqua waters with mountain backdrops made with photos options!

Review Title: Amazing, 1st Class, Unique and Brillant - 5 Islands Experience
Review Text:
From the time we booked online - our 5 Islands Experience - to the end of the trip, it was nothing but an amazing experience. Eric is passionate about his business, his dream, his customers and their experience, and that comes thru in everything he does to ensure the customer gets a unique perspective off the 5 islands of Maui county, and an amazing view and experience.

Flying first up the Nakalele Coast to see the blowhole, around towards Kapalua and Honolua Bay, and then across to Molokai to see the sea-cliffs via “elephant island”, Eric ensured he eliminated the bumps and that everyone got the same view in one form or another. His knowledge gained from flying seaplanes on the East River meant he read the wind on the sea, and judged perfectly where to position the plane to avoid unnecessary turbulence and maximise the customer experience.

The sea-cliffs are awe inspiring... a sight to behold, you can see why Stephen Speilberg used them in the opening scene of Jurassic Park. Again Eric using his local knowledge and experience positioned the plane in such a manner to give us a unique perspective that has imprinted those cliffs in my memory forever. They tower above you and reach way below you to the water, the waterfalls are spectacular and add to the jurassic feel of the cliffs.

Crossing Molokai, and heading across to Lanai we got to look back on Maui and enjoyed both a unique view of the Maui Valley, and a view of Haleakala - who graciously lifted her hat (poked her head thru the clouds) for us to see the observatory’s on the summit of the volcano). Once over Lanai, Eric shared with us the beautiful coral reefs that protect Lanai and we got to enjoyed the “Grand Canyon” of Lanai, flying up and over the ancient river, before turning to head for Molokini.

Eric’s passion for what he does and how he does it comes out here, as he circled Molokini, the beaches at Makena (big and small beach) and the lava fields at the end of Maui to ensure we both got to see and take it all in, before making a final few turns, travelling up the Wailea/Kuhei coastline, and down the valley to land us safely back where all the fun began.

Eric, your energy, passion and desire to see your dream come alive is second to none. Thank you for an amazing experience, when we return to Maui, we will ensure we come flying again. Thank you for sharing the beauty of your Islands with us.

Review Title: WOW --What views on our guided flight over beautiful Maui!
Review Text:
We were so lucky to find this newish company in This Week Maui, among the free booklets from the airport.
Excellent value and exactly what we'd hoped for as we prefer a plane over a noisy helicopter which we'd taken on the Big Island.
This was perfect for the 3 of us (including 2 seniors citizens) and is smaller and more comfortable with easier access than planes we'd taken with a Seattle company around Puget Sound --we had very personalized and clear communication with the experienced pilot, Eric, who explained what we were seeing and answered all our questions.
It was so interesting to listen in on the frequent conversations with ground control as the competent and careful Eric checked in with each one.
We were only about 1000 feet up so had great views everything, including Humped Backed Whale families, the Road to Hana, kite-boarders, details of various beaches, Haleakala, W. Maui Mountain, resorts N of Lahaina, and also the island Kahoolawe, which is inaccessible since it still contains unexploded bombs used for practice during WW 2 and afterward.
It was so much fun for our son --and amazing for us to see details of the many places he'd bicycled to.
A bonus was that Eric had taken some photos of us and the views during and before the flight and promptly emailed them. Our photos turned out great and are a wonderful memory of fun visiting our son.
Just can't recommend this highly enough and we plan to repeat this experience when we visit again!

We covered the exact route as expected and saw amazing views of the islands. The total time in the air was just a tad over 60 minutes. He narrates as you go and likes to make a lot of jokes. The only thing you might want to consider is that gratuities are not included in the fee. Review Title: Excellent Maui County Five Island Experience
Review Text:
Our five island tour started out overlooking West Maui and then we set across the channel to the Molokai sea cliffs...just beautiful. We then circled around for a 180-degree view of cliffs/waterfalls with fluffy clouds capping the top of the escarpment. Then off over to the high grounds of rural Molokai. After that it was over water for some whale viewing and side viewing Lanai. Next we were across the water again to Kaha'ovlawe (excellent view of the Maui from this segment). A quick jaunt over to Molokini with a few 180 degree circles and then we turned to Big and Little Beaches and final S turns over south Maui and some S turns over our resort. We approached the airport and saw the original airport (now a drag racing venue).

We weren't able to go around the northwest side due to weather but our pilot Eric modified the final moments to include more viewing over the resorts and central valley.
I highly recommend this experience as it was private and on a leisurely pace with more time to soak in the area. We left exhilarated ready to enjoy the sun and fun at the beach. Looking forward to a future visit and flight to the Big Island of Hawaii or O'ahu.

Pick your most adventurous person to sit up front and practice flying a single engine plane along with the pilot and take the best photos out of the window port. Super fun!!

Review Title: Amazing plane ride, learnt how to fly by myself!!
Review Text:
My girlfriend and I have always wanted to learn how to fly a plane. We just never pulled the trigger on a lesson back home. On our trip to Maui, we came across Maui Plane Rides and boy was it an amazing ride. We have never flown in a small single engine plane but we were immediately put at easy by our instructor. He explained how the plane flies, what makes it turn, descend, and climb and also all the instruments on the dashboard. From the very beginning, I was able to be on the controls and with the help of the instructor I took off and made a left turn for Molokai. We flew along the highest cliffs in the world on north shore Molokai - it is totally deserted and reminds you of Jurassic Park. We landed on the small airport of Kalaupapa where the Leper colony was established in 1860'. The tiny airport has a lot of information on the history of the colony and after taking a brief brake, we swapped seats and my girlfriend flew this time. We took off and crossed the cliffs onwards to the shipwrecks of Lanai.
Lanai is privately owned by Larry Ellison and we managed to fly over the Manele Bay where Bill Gates got married. We then continued to Molokini where we were going to go snorkel the next day and it was great to see the tiny semi-submerged crater from the air the day before. Then we turned the Makena corner and flew to Hana, passing the oceanfront church where Charles Lindbergh is buried. We also saw the Seven Secret Pools from the air, the Jurassic Rock, the Liberty Rock and a ton of waterfalls.... truly spectacular.
By the time we were on final approach, my girlfriend was flying on her own under the guidance of our instructor.
This was a truly spectacular ride that finally pushed us and we decided to continue with flight lessons back home.... mahalo Maui Plane Rides!!!

Review Title: Amazing Maui air tour experience, incredible photos, heart-pounding thrills, saved lots of $$$
Review Text:
My fiance and I had a breathtaking experience here, a smooth flight with a super friendly and easy going pilot.

We wanted to see the Sea Cliffs of Molokai island, as we had heard they're the tallest in the world, with waterfalls that fall 3000 feet from the top, straight down into the ocean! We looked around at some other options, the usual thing there everybody does, all were double the price for the both of us, and they couldn't guarantee window seats, it was shorter flight time, and we'd be flying with a group of strangers.

The Maui plane ride was way less, a longer flight, a private experience, and we were the only ones. I even was able to fly the plane, which was thrilling, and easier and more fun than I ever thought it could be!

We met at the airport, using the driving directions on the website and then we were taking off a few minutes later. We flew above the coast of Maui, which was rugged and looked beautiful from the air. The Maui plane rides was smooth, and flew at a slower pace which let us take in the views as I was coached by the pilot on how to keep the wings level- It was so much fun! The sensation of lifting up into the sky and then driving the plane was something I'll remember for the rest of my life! My fiance loved every minute of it, and it was a highlight of our time on Maui, without a doubt.

If you're on Maui, and want something easy, fun, and comparably affordable among air activities, Maui plane rides is highly recommended. I think maybe they're a newer business, because I see this is the first review(?). The pilots who fly are professional pilots and flight instructors who make the flight and lesson so much fun, from start to finish. I really do wish them well and we want to support them, because they clearly love what they do, they do it well, and they do it for, honestly, a lot less than anyone else we saw.

We were really impressed and totally thrilled by our Maui plane rides flight and lesson.
